column1: # kind|MM-DD|year|Greek title or name|English title or name|English text   (English texts of the entries; made from the Greek data)

event|01-15|1950|Το δημοψήφισμα της Εκκλησίας για την Ένωση|The Church plebiscite for Union|Greek Cypriots signed in favour of union with Greece, and an overwhelming majority voted "yes" in the initiative of Makarios II and the Ethnarchy.

event|02-24|2008|Ο Δημήτρης Χριστόφιας εκλέγεται πρόεδρος|Dimitris Christofias is elected president|The AKEL leader won the second round and became the first communist head of state of a European Union member state.
event|03-04|1964|Το Συμβούλιο Ασφαλείας στέλνει ειρηνευτική δύναμη|The Security Council sends a peacekeeping force|UN Resolution 186 established UNFICYP, which remains on the island to this day.

event|03-25|2013|Συμφωνία διάσωσης με την Ευρωπαϊκή Ένωση|Bailout agreement with the European Union|After weeks of crisis, Cyprus agreed a assistance programme with the European Stability Mechanism and the IMF, and the closure of Laiki Bank.
event|03-28|1957|Αφήνεται ελεύθερος ο Μακάριος|Makarios is released|The British released the archbishop from the Seychelles, on condition that he would not return to Cyprus. He settled in Athens.
event|07-11|2011|Η έκρηξη στο Μαρί|The Mari explosion|An explosion near the "Evangelos Florakis" naval base killed thirteen people and destroyed the largest power plant in Cyprus.
event|10-21|1931|Τα Οκτωβριανά|The October Events|Greek Cypriot demonstrators burned Government House in Nicosia, demanding union with Greece, and the British imposed draconian measures.

event|12-13|1959|Ο Μακάριος εκλέγεται πρώτος πρόεδρος|Makarios is elected first president|In the elections before independence, Makarios defeated Ioannis Clerides and became president of the Republic of Cyprus.

event|02-15|1999|Η σύλληψη του Αμπντουλάχ Οτσαλάν|The capture of Abdullah Öcalan|The PKK leader was captured in Kenya after his stay at the Greek embassy in Nairobi, an event that caused a political crisis in Greece.

event|11-25|1942|Ανατινάζεται η γέφυρα του Γοργοπόταμου|The Gorgopotamos bridge is blown up|Resistance groups of EDES and ELAS, with British saboteurs, cut the railway line that supplied the Axis in North Africa.
event|11-27|1919|Η συνθήκη του Νεϊγύ|The Treaty of Neuilly|Bulgaria ceded Western Thrace to the Allies, and the region later passed to Greece.

event|12-01|1913|Υψώνεται η ελληνική σημαία στα Χανιά|The Greek flag is raised in Chania|The official union of Crete with Greece was celebrated with the raising of the flag at Firka fortress, in the presence of King Constantine and Eleftherios Venizelos.
event|04-01|1976|Ιδρύεται η Apple|Apple is founded|Steve Jobs, Steve Wozniak and Ronald Wayne founded the company in a garage in California.
event|04-05|1722|Ο Γιάκομπ Ρογκέβεν βρίσκει το Νησί του Πάσχα|Jacob Roggeveen finds Easter Island|The Dutch explorer anchored at the island on Easter Day, and so it got its name.
event|04-29|1945|Οι Αμερικανοί απελευθερώνουν το Νταχάου|The Americans liberate Dachau|The first Nazi concentration camp, near Munich, was liberated by the American army.

event|06-09|1815|Υπογράφεται η τελική πράξη του Συνεδρίου της Βιέννης|The final act of the Congress of Vienna is signed|The victors of the Napoleonic wars redrew the map of Europe and tried to secure a balance of power.

event|07-02|1964|Ο πρόεδρος Τζόνσον υπογράφει τον Νόμο για τα Πολιτικά Δικαιώματα|President Johnson signs the Civil Rights Act|The law banned racial discrimination in schools, workplaces and public places.
event|07-10|1925|Αρχίζει η δίκη του Σκόουπς|The Scopes Trial begins|In Dayton, Tennessee, a teacher was tried for teaching the theory of evolution, and the case became famous all over the world.
event|08-28|1963|Η ομιλία «Έχω ένα όνειρο»|The "I Have a Dream" speech|Martin Luther King spoke in front of 250,000 people in Washington, at the great civil rights march.
event|09-10|2008|Ο Μεγάλος Επιταχυντής Αδρονίων ξεκινά|The Large Hadron Collider starts up|At CERN the first particle beam was sent through the largest accelerator in the world.

event|09-15|1830|Ανοίγει η σιδηροδρομική γραμμή Λίβερπουλ-Μάντσεστερ|The Liverpool and Manchester railway opens|It was the first line with regular timetabled services of steam-powered trains between two cities.
event|11-06|1860|Ο Αβραάμ Λίνκολν εκλέγεται πρόεδρος|Abraham Lincoln is elected president|The election of an anti-slavery candidate led the southern states to secede and to civil war.

event|11-18|1928|Η πρεμιέρα του «Steamboat Willie»|The premiere of "Steamboat Willie"|In the cartoon featuring Mickey Mouse, picture and sound were synchronised, and the career of the character began.
event|12-10|1901|Απονέμονται τα πρώτα βραβεία Νόμπελ|The first Nobel Prizes are awarded|The prizes were given in Stockholm, five years after the death of Alfred Nobel.

event|12-14|1911|Ο Ρόαλντ Αμούνσεν φτάνει στον Νότιο Πόλο|Roald Amundsen reaches the South Pole|The Norwegian explorer and his team were the first to reach the southernmost point of the Earth, five weeks before Scott's British expedition.
event|12-15|1791|Επικυρώνεται η Διακήρυξη Δικαιωμάτων|The Bill of Rights is ratified|The first ten amendments to the US Constitution secured individual freedoms, such as speech and religion.
event|12-17|1903|Η πρώτη πτήση των αδελφών Ράιτ|The Wright brothers' first flight|At Kitty Hawk, North Carolina, their aeroplane flew for 12 seconds, and it was the first powered flight.
event|12-25|800|Ο Καρλομάγνος στέφεται αυτοκράτορας|Charlemagne is crowned emperor|Pope Leo III crowned him in Rome, and the act divided the West even further from Byzantium.

event|12-28|1895|Η πρώτη δημόσια προβολή των αδελφών Λουμιέρ|The Lumière brothers' first public screening|In Paris spectators paid for a ticket to see moving pictures, and it is considered the birth of cinema.
event|12-28|1908|Ο σεισμός της Μεσσίνας|The Messina earthquake|One of the deadliest earthquakes in Europe and the tsunami that followed killed tens of thousands of people in Sicily and Calabria.
event|12-31|1999|Παραιτείται ο Μπορίς Γέλτσιν|Boris Yeltsin resigns|Russia's first president handed over power to Vladimir Putin on the last day of the millennium.
event|01-16|1920|Αρχίζει η Ποτοαπαγόρευση|Prohibition begins|The 18th Amendment came into force, banning the production and sale of alcohol for 13 years.
event|01-21|1793|Εκτελείται ο Λουδοβίκος ΙΣΤ΄|Louis XVI is executed|The King of France was beheaded in Paris, a few months after the abolition of the monarchy.
event|01-23|1849|Η Ελίζαμπεθ Μπλάκγουελ γίνεται η πρώτη γυναίκα γιατρός|Elizabeth Blackwell becomes the first woman doctor|She received her medical degree in New York, despite objections.
event|01-27|1945|Ο Κόκκινος Στρατός απελευθερώνει το Άουσβιτς|The Red Army liberates Auschwitz|The day became International Holocaust Remembrance Day.

event|05-20|325|Αρχίζει η Α΄ Οικουμενική Σύνοδος της Νίκαιας|The First Ecumenical Council of Nicaea begins|The bishops convened by Constantine condemned Arianism and formulated the first part of the Creed.

event|07-25|1261|Ο Μιχαήλ Η΄ ανακτά την Κωνσταντινούπολη|Michael VIII recovers Constantinople|The general Alexios Strategopoulos entered the city held by the Latins since 1204, and so the Latin Empire came to an end.

event|08-15|718|Τελειώνει η δεύτερη αραβική πολιορκία της Κωνσταντινούπολης|The second Arab siege of Constantinople ends|Emperor Leo III and the Bulgarian army repulsed the Arabs, and the city remained a bulwark of Europe.
event|08-09|378|Η μάχη της Αδριανούπολης|The Battle of Adrianople|The Goths destroyed the Roman army of Valens and the emperor was killed, and the defeat opened the way to the Balkans.
event|10-01|-331|Η μάχη των Γαυγαμήλων|The Battle of Gaugamela|Alexander the Great defeated Darius III of Persia and opened the way to Babylon. The date is the traditional one.

event|06-10|-323|Πεθαίνει ο Μέγας Αλέξανδρος|Alexander the Great dies|The king of Macedonia died in Babylon at the age of 32, and his empire was divided among his generals. The date is 10 or 11 June, according to the sources.

event|01-01|-45|Τίθεται σε ισχύ το Ιουλιανό ημερολόγιο|The Julian calendar takes effect|Julius Caesar introduced it on the advice of the Greek astronomer Sosigenes, and it was the calendar of Europe for 1,600 years.
event|01-16|-27|Ο Οκταβιανός παίρνει τον τίτλο «Αύγουστος»|Octavian takes the title "Augustus"|The Senate gave him the title, and so the Roman Empire began.
event|08-02|-216|Η μάχη των Καννών|The Battle of Cannae|Hannibal encircled and destroyed the Roman army, in one of the greatest military successes of antiquity.

event|09-04|476|Καθαιρείται ο τελευταίος δυτικός αυτοκράτορας|The last Western emperor is deposed|Odoacer removed the young Romulus Augustulus from the throne, and the end of the Western Roman Empire is placed on this date.
event|07-03|324|Η μάχη της Αδριανούπολης|The Battle of Adrianople|Constantine defeated Licinius and took the whole eastern empire into his hands.
event|09-18|324|Η μάχη της Χρυσόπολης|The Battle of Chrysopolis|Constantine decisively defeated Licinius across from Byzantium and became sole emperor.
event|06-26|363|Πεθαίνει ο αυτοκράτορας Ιουλιανός|Emperor Julian dies|Julian was mortally wounded in a clash during his campaign against the Persians.
event|09-06|394|Η μάχη του Φριγίδου|The Battle of the Frigidus|Theodosius I defeated Eugenius and reunited the empire under one ruler.
event|01-17|395|Πεθαίνει ο Θεοδόσιος Α΄|Theodosius I dies|The last emperor who ruled the whole Roman state died in Milan, and his sons divided the empire.
event|08-24|410|Οι Βησιγότθοι λεηλατούν τη Ρώμη|The Visigoths sack Rome|Alaric entered the city and plundered it for three days, an event that made a great impression across the world of the time.
event|12-09|536|Ο Βελισάριος μπαίνει στη Ρώμη|Belisarius enters Rome|Justinian's general took the city without a fight, at the start of the effort to recover Italy.
event|12-12|627|Η μάχη της Νινευή|The Battle of Nineveh|Heraclius defeated the Persians and ended the great war that had brought the state close to collapse.
event|09-24|787|Αρχίζει η Ζ΄ Οικουμενική Σύνοδος|The Seventh Ecumenical Council begins|The bishops at Nicaea restored the veneration of icons.
event|03-11|843|Η Αναστήλωση των εικόνων|The Restoration of the icons|Empress Theodora and Patriarch Methodios restored the icons for good, and the feast was named the Sunday of Orthodoxy.
event|05-21|878|Πέφτει η Συρακούσα|Syracuse falls|The Arabs captured Syracuse, the last major Byzantine city of Sicily.
event|07-31|904|Οι Άραβες καταλαμβάνουν τη Θεσσαλονίκη|The Arabs capture Thessaloniki|The fleet of Leo of Tripoli sacked the empire's second city and took thousands of prisoners.
event|08-16|963|Στέφεται ο Νικηφόρος Φωκάς|Nikephoros Phokas is crowned|The general who had recaptured Crete became emperor, and married Theophano, the widow of Romanos II.
event|07-29|1014|Η μάχη του Κλειδίου|The Battle of Kleidion|Basil II defeated the army of Tsar Samuel, and the Byzantine emperor went down in history with the epithet Bulgar-slayer.
event|12-15|1025|Πεθαίνει ο Βασίλειος Β΄|Basil II dies|The emperor who led Byzantium to its greatest height died, leaving no children.
event|10-18|1081|Η μάχη του Δυρραχίου|The Battle of Dyrrhachium|The Norman Robert Guiscard defeated Alexios I Komnenos, at the start of the Norman attack on the Balkans.
event|04-29|1091|Η μάχη του Λεβουνίου|The Battle of Levounion|Alexios I Komnenos defeated the Pechenegs and began a new period of security for the state.
event|07-01|1097|Η μάχη του Δορυλαίου|The Battle of Dorylaeum|The Crusaders defeated the Seljuks, in the first major battle of the First Crusade.
event|09-17|1176|Η μάχη του Μυριοκέφαλου|The Battle of Myriokephalon|Manuel I Komnenos was defeated by the Seljuks, and hopes of reconquering Asia Minor were lost.
event|05-16|1204|Στέφεται ο Βαλδουίνος Α΄|Baldwin I is crowned|The Count of Flanders was crowned in Hagia Sophia as emperor of the Latin Empire of the East.
event|04-14|1205|Η μάχη της Αδριανούπολης|The Battle of Adrianople|The Bulgarian tsar Kaloyan defeated the Latins and captured Baldwin I.
event|08-26|1346|Η μάχη του Κρεσύ|The Battle of Crécy|The English archers defeated the French, in one of the first battles of the Hundred Years' War.
event|09-25|1396|Η μάχη της Νικόπολης|The Battle of Nicopolis|Bayezid I defeated the army of the crusaders, who had come to save Constantinople.
event|07-28|1402|Η μάχη της Άγκυρας|The Battle of Ankara|Tamerlane defeated and captured Bayezid, and the Ottoman defeat gave Byzantium a breathing space of a few decades.
event|05-08|1429|Άρση της πολιορκίας της Ορλεάνης|The siege of Orléans is lifted|Joan of Arc led the French, who freed the city from the English.

event|07-06|1439|Η ένωση των Εκκλησιών στη Φλωρεντία|The union of the Churches at Florence|The Council of Florence signed the union of the Eastern and Western Churches, which most Byzantines rejected.
event|11-10|1444|Η μάχη της Βάρνας|The Battle of Varna|Murad II defeated the crusaders of King Vladislaus, who fell in the battle.
event|01-06|1449|Στέφεται ο Κωνσταντίνος ΙΑ΄ Παλαιολόγος|Constantine XI Palaiologos is crowned|The last emperor of Byzantium was crowned at Mystras.

event|12-12|1452|Η ένωση των Εκκλησιών στην Αγία Σοφία|The union of the Churches in Hagia Sophia|Cardinal Isidore celebrated a liturgy in Hagia Sophia proclaiming the union, five months before the Fall. Many of the faithful refused to take part.
event|08-15|1461|Πέφτει η Τραπεζούντα|Trebizond falls|Mehmed II captured the city and ended the Empire of Trebizond, the last fragment of Byzantium.

event|02-14|1993|Ο Γλαύκος Κληρίδης εκλέγεται πρόεδρος της Κύπρου|Glafcos Clerides is elected president of Cyprus|Glafcos Clerides won narrowly in the presidential elections and governed the island until 2003.

event|02-19|1959|Οι συμφωνίες Ζυρίχης-Λονδίνου για την Κύπρο|The Zurich-London agreements on Cyprus|Greece, Turkey and Britain agreed to create an independent Cypriot state, which was proclaimed on 16 August 1960.

event|03-08|1970|Αποτυχημένη απόπειρα κατά του Μακαρίου|A failed attempt on Makarios|President Makarios's helicopter came under fire after taking off from the Presidential Palace in Nicosia. Makarios was slightly wounded.

event|03-14|1957|Απαγχονίζεται ο Ευαγόρας Παλληκαρίδης|Evagoras Pallikarides is hanged|The nineteen-year-old EOKA fighter was executed by the British authorities in the Nicosia prison. He became a symbol of the Cypriot struggle.

event|04-01|1955|Η ΕΟΚΑ ξεκινά τον απελευθερωτικό αγώνα|EOKA begins the liberation struggle|The National Organisation of Cypriot Fighters, led by Georgios Grivas, carried out the first attacks against the British authorities in Cyprus.

event|04-24|2004|Οι Ελληνοκύπριοι απορρίπτουν το Σχέδιο Ανάν|Greek Cypriots reject the Annan Plan|In a referendum, 76% of Greek Cypriots rejected the United Nations plan for a solution to the Cyprus problem. The Turkish Cypriots had accepted it.

event|05-01|2004|Η Κύπρος εντάσσεται στην Ευρωπαϊκή Ένωση|Cyprus joins the European Union|Together with nine other countries, the Republic of Cyprus became a member of the EU. European law applies in the areas controlled by the government.

event|06-04|1878|Η Κύπρος περνά στη Βρετανία|Cyprus passes to Britain|With the Cyprus Convention, the Ottoman Empire handed the administration of the island to the British Empire, while sovereignty remained Ottoman. Britain annexed it in 1914.

event|07-15|1974|Το πραξικόπημα κατά του Μακαρίου στην Κύπρο|The coup against Makarios in Cyprus|The National Guard, with the support of the Athens dictatorship, overthrew President Makarios. Nikos Sampson took over the presidency.

event|07-20|1974|Η τουρκική εισβολή στην Κύπρο|The Turkish invasion of Cyprus|Turkish troops landed in the northern part of Cyprus, citing the coup as a pretext. The division of the island followed, and it continues.
event|08-14|1974|Η δεύτερη φάση της τουρκικής εισβολής|The second phase of the Turkish invasion|After the breakdown of the Geneva talks, Turkish troops advanced and occupied about 36% of Cyprus.

event|08-16|1960|Η Κύπρος γίνεται ανεξάρτητο κράτος|Cyprus becomes an independent state|The Republic of Cyprus was proclaimed, following the Zurich-London agreements. The first president was Archbishop Makarios III.

event|11-05|2006|Ο Χρυσόστομος Β΄ εκλέγεται Αρχιεπίσκοπος Κύπρου|Chrysostomos II is elected Archbishop of Cyprus|Metropolitan Chrysostomos of Paphos was elected Archbishop of New Justiniana and All Cyprus. He remained in the post until his death in 2022.

event|11-15|1983|Η μονομερής ανακήρυξη του κατεχομένου βορρά|The unilateral declaration of the occupied north|The Turkish Cypriot leadership declared the "Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus". UN Security Council Resolution 541 considered the declaration legally invalid.

event|12-13|2002|Η Ευρωπαϊκή Ένωση αποφασίζει την ένταξη της Κύπρου|The European Union decides on Cyprus's accession|At the Copenhagen Summit, the EU decided to admit ten new members, including Cyprus, from 2004.

event|12-21|1963|Τα επεισόδια των Χριστουγέννων του 1963 στην Κύπρο|The Christmas 1963 violence in Cyprus|Bloody intercommunal clashes between Greek Cypriots and Turkish Cypriots, which led to the breakdown of cooperation between the two communities and to the presence of UN forces.

event|05-10|1956|Απαγχονίζονται οι Μιχαλάκης Καραολής και Ανδρέας Δημητρίου|Michalakis Karaolis and Andreas Dimitriou are hanged|Two EOKA fighters were executed by the British authorities in the Central Prisons of Nicosia. They became symbols of the Cypriot struggle.

event|08-19|1974|Δολοφονείται ο Αμερικανός πρέσβης Ρότζερ Ντέιβις|US Ambassador Rodger Davies is assassinated|The US ambassador to Cyprus was killed by gunfire in Nicosia, during a demonstration against the Turkish invasion. The US took diplomatic initiatives.

event|12-30|1963|Χαράσσεται η Πράσινη Γραμμή στη Λευκωσία|The Green Line is drawn in Nicosia|After the violent events of Christmas, the British general Peter Young drew with a green pencil the line that divided Nicosia in two. It was the first partition of the city.
event|01-01|2008|Η Κύπρος υιοθετεί το ευρώ|Cyprus adopts the euro|Together with Malta, Cyprus joined the eurozone and the Cypriot pound was replaced by the common currency.
event|02-27|1938|Γεννιέται ο Ευαγόρας Παλληκαρίδης|Evagoras Pallikarides is born|The young schoolboy from Lysi became a member of EOKA and one of the symbols of the struggle, and was hanged at 18.

event|03-09|1956|Συλλαμβάνεται ο Μακάριος και εξορίζεται στις Σεϋχέλλες|Makarios is arrested and exiled to the Seychelles|The British arrested him at Nicosia airport together with Papastavrou and two others, and took them into exile.
event|04-23|2003|Ανοίγουν τα οδοφράγματα της Πράσινης Γραμμής|The Green Line crossing points open|For the first time since 1974, Cypriots could cross freely to the other side of the island.
event|07-01|1570|Οι Οθωμανοί αποβιβάζονται στην Κύπρο|The Ottomans land in Cyprus|The army of Lala Mustafa Pasha landed near Larnaca and began the conquest of the island from the Venetians.
event|07-09|1821|Εκτελείται ο Αρχιεπίσκοπος Κυπριανός|Archbishop Kyprianos is executed|The Ottomans hanged the Archbishop and the metropolitans in Nicosia, in reprisal for the Greek Revolution.

event|07-23|1974|Η Χούντα καταρρέει και ο Γλαύκος Κληρίδης αναλαμβάνει την προεδρία|The Junta collapses and Glafcos Clerides takes over the presidency|After the Turkish invasion Nikos Sampson resigned and the President of the House took over the duties of president on an interim basis.
event|08-01|1571|Πέφτει η Αμμόχωστος|Famagusta falls|After a siege of eleven months the Venetians surrendered to the Ottomans, and the whole of Cyprus came under Ottoman rule.
event|08-03|1977|Πεθαίνει ο Αρχιεπίσκοπος Μακάριος Γ΄|Archbishop Makarios III dies|The first president of the Republic of Cyprus died of a heart attack and was succeeded by Spyros Kyprianou.
event|08-08|1964|Η τουρκική αεροπορία βομβαρδίζει την Τηλλυρία|The Turkish air force bombs Tylliria|Turkish aircraft attacked the area for several days, causing casualties and damage in the villages.

event|08-11|1996|Σκοτώνεται ο Τάσος Ισαάκ|Tassos Isaac is killed|The young Cypriot was murdered by Turkish nationalists in the buffer zone at Deryneia, and a few days later Solomos Solomou was also killed.
event|09-09|1570|Πέφτει η Λευκωσία|Nicosia falls|The Ottomans captured the capital after a siege of forty days, with great massacres.

event|05-12|1191|Ο Ριχάρδος Λεοντόκαρδος παντρεύεται στη Λεμεσό|Richard the Lionheart marries in Limassol|The King of England, who had landed on the island a few days earlier, married Berengaria of Navarre there and took Cyprus from Isaac Komnenos.
event|01-27|1974|Πεθαίνει ο Γεώργιος Γρίβας|Georgios Grivas dies|The EOKA leader died in Limassol, where he was living in hiding, and his funeral was attended by great crowds.

event|01-29|2006|Ο Μάρκος Παγδατής στον τελικό του Australian Open|Marcos Baghdatis in the Australian Open final|The Cypriot tennis player reached the final in Melbourne and lost to Roger Federer, in the greatest success in Cypriot tennis.
event|02-04|2018|Ο Νίκος Αναστασιάδης επανεκλέγεται πρόεδρος|Nicos Anastasiades is re-elected president|In the second round of the presidential elections Nicos Anastasiades won a new five-year term.

event|02-12|1977|Η συμφωνία Μακαρίου – Ντενκτάς|The Makarios-Denktash agreement|The two leaders agreed on basic principles for a federal solution, two bizonal and bicommunal regions, but the agreement did not progress in practice.

event|02-12|2023|Ο Νίκος Χριστοδουλίδης εκλέγεται πρόεδρος|Nikos Christodoulides is elected president|In the second round the former foreign minister won and became the eighth president of the Republic of Cyprus.

event|02-13|1975|Ανακηρύσσεται το «Τουρκοκυπριακό Ομόσπονδο Κράτος»|The "Turkish Federated State of Cyprus" is proclaimed|The Turkish Cypriot leadership proclaimed a federated state in the occupied areas, which the Security Council and the Republic of Cyprus did not recognise.

event|02-16|2003|Ο Τάσσος Παπαδόπουλος εκλέγεται πρόεδρος|Tassos Papadopoulos is elected president|He was elected in the first round and took over the negotiations on the Annan Plan and accession to the European Union.
event|02-21|1988|Ο Γιώργος Βασιλείου εκλέγεται πρόεδρος|George Vassiliou is elected president|The independent candidate, supported by AKEL, defeated Glafcos Clerides in the second round.
event|02-24|2013|Ο Νίκος Αναστασιάδης εκλέγεται πρόεδρος|Nicos Anastasiades is elected president|He won in the second round and took office during a period of deep economic crisis.
event|03-01|1959|Ο Μακάριος επιστρέφει στην Κύπρο|Makarios returns to Cyprus|Makarios came back from London, after the Zurich-London agreements, and was welcomed by a huge crowd.
event|03-03|1957|Πεθαίνει ο Γρηγόρης Αυξεντίου|Grigoris Afxentiou dies|The EOKA deputy leader was killed in his hideout near the Machairas monastery, after a long battle with British soldiers.

event|03-07|2012|Ο ΑΠΟΕΛ στους οκτώ του Champions League|APOEL in the Champions League quarter-finals|The Nicosia team beat Lyon on penalties and became the first Cypriot team to reach the last eight of the competition.

event|02-19|1962|Πεθαίνει ο Γεώργιος Παπανικολάου|Georgios Papanikolaou Dies|The Greek doctor, who devised the Pap test for the detection of cervical cancer, died in the USA. The test saved millions of lives.

event|02-21|1973|Η κατάληψη της Νομικής Σχολής Αθηνών|The Occupation of the Athens Law School|Students occupied the Law School and protested against the dictatorship. The mobilization foreshadowed the Polytechnic uprising nine months later.

event|02-23|1943|Η πολιτική επιστράτευση στην Κατοχή|The Civil Mobilization during the Occupation|The occupiers declared a civil mobilization, with the aim of sending Greeks to work in Germany. The large demonstrations that followed forced the government to withdraw it.

event|02-26|2020|Το πρώτο κρούσμα κορονοϊού στην Ελλάδα|The First Coronavirus Case in Greece|The first case of COVID-19 was confirmed, in a woman from Thessaloniki who had travelled to Italy. The country gradually entered a period of restrictions.
event|03-10|1905|Η Επανάσταση του Θερίσου|The Therisso Revolt|Eleftherios Venizelos and his comrades rose up at Therisso in Chania against Prince George, demanding the union of Crete with Greece.

event|03-15|1943|Ο πρώτος συρμός από τη Θεσσαλονίκη προς το Άουσβιτς|The First Train from Thessaloniki to Auschwitz|A train with about 2,800 Jews of Thessaloniki left for the Auschwitz camp. Nineteen more followed, until August, and the community was almost entirely exterminated.

event|03-22|2020|Η Ελλάδα μπαίνει σε καραντίνα|Greece Goes into Lockdown|The prime minister announced restrictions on movement across the country, to limit the spread of the coronavirus. Citizens stayed in their homes for more than two months.

event|04-02|1986|Η βόμβα στην πτήση TWA 840|The Bomb on TWA Flight 840|A bomb explosion on a TWA plane over Argos killed four passengers, among them an infant. The attack was linked to the terrorism of the time.

event|04-10|1826|Η Έξοδος του Μεσολογγίου|The Exodus of Missolonghi|After a siege of one year, the defenders of Missolonghi attempted a night sortie and most were killed. The date is in the old calendar (10 April), by which the day is commemorated.

event|05-01|1944|Οι 200 εκτελεσμένοι της Καισαριανής|The 200 Executed at Kaisariani|The Germans executed 200 communist prisoners at the Kaisariani shooting range, in reprisal for the murder of a general. It was the largest mass execution of the Occupation in Athens.

event|05-02|1941|Πεθαίνει η Πηνελόπη Δέλτα|Penelope Delta Dies|The author of the children's books "In the Secrets of the Swamp" and "Trelantonis" took her own life in Athens, on the day the Germans were already in the city.

event|05-03|1810|Ο Λόρδος Βύρων διασχίζει τον Ελλήσποντο κολυμπώντας|Lord Byron Swims across the Hellespont|The British poet and the officer Ekenhead swam from Sestos to Abydos, imitating the myth of Leander. Byron later became a philhellene and died in Missolonghi.

event|05-06|2012|Οι εκλογές που ανέτρεψαν τον δικομματισμό|The Elections That Overturned the Two-Party System|In the elections, PASOK and New Democracy lost a large part of their electoral strength. No government was formed and a second election followed in June.

event|05-24|1998|Ο Αγγελόπουλος κερδίζει τον Χρυσό Φοίνικα|Angelopoulos Wins the Palme d'Or|The director Theo Angelopoulos was awarded at Cannes for the film "Eternity and a Day", starring Bruno Ganz.

event|05-26|1916|Η παράδοση του οχυρού Ρούπελ|The Surrender of Fort Rupel|In the First World War, the Greek army handed Fort Rupel over to the Germans and Bulgarians, and Eastern Macedonia effectively passed into foreign hands. The event deepened the National Schism.

event|06-02|1941|Η σφαγή του Κοντομαρί|The Massacre of Kontomari|German paratroopers executed dozens of civilians in the village of Kontomari in Crete, in reprisal for the villagers' participation in the Battle of Crete.

event|06-08|1995|Το casus belli της Τουρκίας|Turkey's Casus Belli|The Turkish National Assembly gave the country's government approval to declare war if Greece extends its territorial waters to 12 nautical miles. The threat still stands.

event|06-12|1914|Η σφαγή της Φώκαιας|The Massacre of Phocaea|Turkish irregulars attacked the Greek town of Phocaea in Asia Minor, killed and plundered, and the Greek population was expelled. It was one of the first episodes of the persecution of the Greeks of the East.

event|06-25|1925|Ο Πάγκαλος καταλύει τη Δημοκρατία|Pangalos Overthrows the Republic|General Theodoros Pangalos declared a dictatorship and was later proclaimed President of the Republic, until he was overthrown by Georgios Kondylis in 1926.

event|06-26|2007|Ο καύσωνας των 47,5°C|The 47.5°C Heatwave|The strongest heatwave of recent decades brought a temperature of 47.5 degrees Celsius to Athens and caused large fires. The temperature was among the highest recorded in the country.

event|06-28|2015|Η Ελλάδα ξυπνά με κλειστές τράπεζες|Greece Wakes Up with Closed Banks|The government announced capital controls. The banks closed for about three weeks and ATM withdrawals were limited to 60 euros a day.

event|06-30|1913|Η σφαγή του Δοξάτου|The Massacre of Doxato|In the Second Balkan War, Bulgarian soldiers killed hundreds of Greek civilians at Doxato in Drama and set the village on fire. The destruction was recorded by the Carnegie Commission.

event|07-11|1988|Η επίθεση στο κρουαζιερόπλοιο «City of Poros»|The Attack on the Cruise Ship "City of Poros"|Terrorists fired shots and threw grenades at the Greek cruise ship off Aegina, and killed nine people, among them children.

event|07-14|1992|Η δολοφονία Αξαρλιάν|The Axarlian Murder|The terrorist organization "17 November" murdered the businessman Thanos Axarlian, and continued its attacks on politicians, businessmen and foreign diplomats.

event|07-15|1965|Παραιτείται ο Γεώργιος Παπανδρέου|Georgios Papandreou Resigns|After a clash with King Constantine, Prime Minister Georgios Papandreou resigned. The crisis that followed is known as the Iouliana and led to the dictatorship of 1967.
event|07-17|1912|Η Ελευθέρα Πολιτεία της Ικαρίας|The Free State of Ikaria|The Ikarians drove out the Ottomans and proclaimed Ikaria independent. A few months later, the island united with Greece.

event|07-19|2010|Η δολοφονία του δημοσιογράφου Σωκράτη Γκιόλια|The Murder of the Journalist Sokratis Giolias|The journalist Sokratis Giolias was murdered outside his home in Athens. The case remains unsolved.

event|07-22|1974|Η επιχείρηση «Νίκη» στην Κύπρο|Operation "Niki" in Cyprus|Greek aircraft carried commandos to Cyprus, after the Turkish invasion, and some were hit by friendly fire. The mission cost lives.

event|07-30|1920|Απόπειρα δολοφονίας του Βενιζέλου|Assassination Attempt on Venizelos|At the Gare de Lyon in Paris, two Greek officers shot Prime Minister Eleftherios Venizelos and wounded him. The event sharpened the National Schism.

event|08-05|1973|Η επίθεση στο αεροδρόμιο του Ελληνικού|The Attack at Hellinikon Airport|Palestinian terrorists attacked the airport's waiting room with gunfire and grenades and killed three people. The target was another flight.
event|08-10|1920|Η Συνθήκη των Σεβρών|The Treaty of Sevres|The peace treaty with the Ottoman Empire gave Greece Thrace and Smyrna, but it was never implemented, as Kemal Ataturk rejected it.

event|08-17|1944|Το Μπλόκο της Κοκκινιάς|The Kokkinia Blockade|Germans and Security Battalion men surrounded Kokkinia and arrested thousands of men. Hundreds were executed and the neighbourhood became a symbol of the Resistance.

event|08-20|1954|Η πρώτη προσφυγή της Ελλάδας στον ΟΗΕ για το Κυπριακό|Greece's First Appeal to the UN on the Cyprus Issue|The Greek government asked the UN to examine the self-determination of the Cypriot people. The proposal was not accepted, but the Cyprus issue became an international matter.

event|08-22|1926|Ο Κονδύλης ανατρέπει τον Πάγκαλο|Kondylis Overthrows Pangalos|General Georgios Kondylis carried out a coup, overthrew the dictatorship of Theodoros Pangalos and opened the way for the return to democracy.

event|09-01|1911|Το «Αβέρωφ» μπαίνει στην υπηρεσία του Πολεμικού Ναυτικού|The "Averof" Enters Service with the Navy|The armoured cruiser, a donation by Georgios Averof, arrived in Greece and became the flagship of the fleet. It contributed decisively to the victories of the Balkan Wars.

event|09-04|1944|Η ελληνική σημαία ξαναϋψώνεται στην Προσοτσάνη|The Greek Flag Is Raised Again at Prosotsani|Two residents took down the Bulgarian flag and raised the Greek one, at the end of the Bulgarian occupation of Eastern Macedonia and Thrace.

event|09-05|1944|Η εκτέλεση της Ηρώς Κωνσταντοπούλου|The Execution of Iro Konstantopoulou|The seventeen-year-old resistance member was executed by the Germans at the Kaisariani shooting range, together with 49 other Greeks, because she did not betray her comrades.

event|09-21|2018|Ο θάνατος του Ζακ Κωστόπουλου|The Death of Zak Kostopoulos|The activist Zak Kostopoulos died in Athens after an attack outside a jewellery shop on Gladstonos Street. The case provoked a major public debate.

event|09-28|2013|Συλλαμβάνονται ηγετικά στελέχη της Χρυσής Αυγής|Golden Dawn Leaders Are Arrested|After the murder of Pavlos Fyssas, the police arrested the leader and members of parliament of Golden Dawn. The party was later tried as a criminal organization.

event|10-07|1944|Η εξέγερση στο Άουσβιτς|The Auschwitz Uprising|Members of the special group of prisoners who worked in the gas chambers, among them Greek Jews, rose up at Auschwitz and blew up one of the crematoria.

event|11-03|1944|Κυκλοφορεί το χαρτονόμισμα των 100 δισεκατομμυρίων δραχμών|The 100 Billion Drachma Banknote Is Issued|In the most extreme inflation of the Occupation, the Bank of Greece issued a banknote worth 100 billion drachmas. Its value fell within a few days.
event|11-05|1961|Η φονική πλημμύρα της Αθήνας|The Deadly Flood of Athens|Torrential rains flooded neighbourhoods of Athens, killed 31 people, and left thousands homeless.

event|11-15|2017|Η φονική πλημμύρα στη Μάνδρα|The Deadly Flood at Mandra|Within half an hour, a torrent inundated Mandra in Attica and killed at least 23 people. The disaster brought flood protection works into the spotlight.

event|11-21|1916|Βυθίζεται το «Βρετανικός» στην Κέα|HMHS Britannic Sinks off Kea|The hospital ship, which was the largest in the world, sank in the Aegean after an explosion. The nurse Violet Jessop survived all three shipwrecks the company experienced.

event|11-23|1988|Συλλαμβάνεται ο Γιώργος Κοσκωτάς|Giorgos Koskotas Is Arrested|The banker Giorgos Koskotas, the central figure of the scandal that shook the government of Andreas Papandreou and brought former ministers to trial, was arrested in the USA.

event|12-19|1923|Ο Γεώργιος Β΄ φεύγει από την Ελλάδα|George II Leaves Greece|After the defeat of the Asia Minor campaign, King George II left the country. A few months later, in 1924, the republic was proclaimed.

event|12-22|1963|Η πυρκαγιά του «Λακωνία»|The Fire on the "Lakonia"|The Greek ocean liner "Lakonia" caught fire near the Madeira islands and about 128 people were killed. It became one of the greatest maritime accidents of the era.

event|12-26|1968|Επίθεση στο αεροσκάφος της El Al στο Ελληνικό|Attack on an El Al Aircraft at Hellinikon|Palestinian gunmen attacked an aircraft of the Israeli company El Al at Hellinikon. Israeli forces responded with an operation in Beirut two days later.

event|03-17|1821|Η Μάνη σηκώνει το λάβαρο της Επανάστασης|Mani Raises the Banner of the Revolution|Petrobey Mavromichalis and the Maniots declared the Revolution at Areopoli. The date is by the old calendar.

event|03-23|1821|Η Καλαμάτα ελευθερώνεται από τους Έλληνες|Kalamata Is Liberated by the Greeks|The chieftains of Messenia and Mani entered Kalamata, which became the first major town of the Revolution in Greek hands. The date is by the old calendar.

event|03-29|1896|Ο Σπύρος Λούης κερδίζει τον πρώτο Ολυμπιακό μαραθώνιο|Spyros Louis Wins the First Olympic Marathon|The water carrier from Marousi ran the Marathon-Athens course first and thrilled the packed Panathenaic Stadium. The date is by the old calendar.

event|04-04|1081|Ο Αλέξιος Κομνηνός στέφεται αυτοκράτορας|Alexios Komnenos Is Crowned Emperor|The general Alexios Komnenos took the throne of Constantinople and founded the Komnenian dynasty, which ruled Byzantium for over a century.

event|05-08|1821|Ο Οδυσσέας Ανδρούτσος αντιστέκεται στο Χάνι της Γραβιάς|Odysseas Androutsos Resists at the Inn of Gravia|With about a hundred men, Androutsos held up the numerous army of Omer Vrioni for a day, gaining time for the Revolution. The date is by the old calendar.

event|06-06|1822|Ο Κανάρης πυρπολεί την ναυαρχίδα του Καρά Αλή στη Χίο|Kanaris Burns Kara Ali's Flagship at Chios|Konstantinos Kanaris burned the Ottoman flagship in the harbour of Chios, a few weeks after the massacre of the island. The date is by the old calendar.

event|06-16|1913|Η Βουλγαρία επιτίθεται σε ελληνικές και σερβικές θέσεις|Bulgaria Attacks Greek and Serbian Positions|The night attack without a declaration of war began the Second Balkan War. The date is by the old calendar.
event|06-21|1824|Καταστρέφονται τα Ψαρά|The Destruction of Psara|The Ottoman fleet and army captured the island and killed or captured thousands of inhabitants. The date is by the old calendar.

event|06-24|1798|Θανατώνεται ο Ρήγας Βελεστινλής|Rigas Velestinlis Is Executed|The poet of the "Thourios" and visionary of a Balkan republic was strangled in Belgrade by the Ottomans and became a symbol of freedom.

event|07-16|1054|Το Σχίσμα των Εκκλησιών|The Schism of the Churches|Cardinal Humbert left on the altar of Hagia Sophia the excommunication of Patriarch Michael Cerularius, a turning point in the separation of the Eastern and Western Churches.

event|07-26|1822|Η νίκη του Κολοκοτρώνη στα Δερβενάκια|Kolokotronis's Victory at Dervenakia|Theodoros Kolokotronis trapped the army of Dramali in the narrow passes and destroyed it, saving the Peloponnese. The date is by the old calendar.

event|08-07|626|Αποκρούεται η πολιορκία της Κωνσταντινούπολης από τους Αβάρους|The Avar Siege of Constantinople Is Repelled|The City withstood the attack of the Avars and Slavs, while the Persians waited on the opposite shore. The deliverance was attributed to the Virgin Mary and linked to the Akathist Hymn.
event|08-12|1204|Η Κρήτη πωλείται στους Βενετούς|Crete Is Sold to the Venetians|Boniface of Montferrat sold the island to Venice after the Fourth Crusade, and Venice held it for over four centuries.

event|08-24|1185|Οι Νορμανδοί καταλαμβάνουν τη Θεσσαλονίκη|The Normans Capture Thessaloniki|After a siege of two weeks, the Normans of Sicily breached the walls and sacked the second city of the Empire.

event|08-25|1898|Η σφαγή του Ηρακλείου|The Massacre of Heraklion|Muslims attacked Christian residents and British soldiers. The event hastened the withdrawal of the Ottoman forces from Crete. The date is by the old calendar.

event|08-27|1922|Ο Χρυσόστομος Σμύρνης θανατώνεται|Chrysostomos of Smyrna Is Killed|The metropolitan, who refused to abandon his flock, was handed over to a mob and killed in Smyrna. The date is by the old calendar.

event|10-04|1974|Ο Κωνσταντίνος Καραμανλής ιδρύει τη Νέα Δημοκρατία|Konstantinos Karamanlis Founds New Democracy|The party was founded a few months after the Metapolitefsi, and its founder was the prime minister of the transition to democracy.

event|10-05|1912|Η Ελλάδα κηρύσσει τον πόλεμο στην Οθωμανική Αυτοκρατορία|Greece Declares War on the Ottoman Empire|With Greece, Bulgaria, Serbia and Montenegro united, the First Balkan War began. The date is by the old calendar.

event|11-24|1826|Ο Καραϊσκάκης νικά στην Αράχωβα|Karaiskakis Wins at Arachova|In the winter of Parnassus, Georgios Karaiskakis crushed the Turkish-Albanians of Mustafa Pasha. The date is by the old calendar.

event|12-11|969|Δολοφονείται ο αυτοκράτορας Νικηφόρος Β΄ Φωκάς|Emperor Nikephoros II Phokas Is Murdered|The general who reconquered Crete and Cyprus was killed inside the palace by conspirators led by John Tzimiskes.

event|12-20|1821|Συνέρχεται η Α΄ Εθνοσυνέλευση της Επιδαύρου|The First National Assembly of Epidaurus Convenes|The delegates of revolutionary Greece gathered to give the Struggle a political form and a constitution. The date is by the old calendar.

event|01-25|2015|Ο ΣΥΡΙΖΑ κερδίζει τις εκλογές|SYRIZA Wins the Elections|In the parliamentary elections the party of Alexis Tsipras won about 36% and formed a government, for the first time with the Left in the premiership.

event|02-27|1968|Ο Ανδρέας Παπανδρέου ανακοινώνει την ίδρυση του ΠΑΚ|Andreas Papandreou Announces the Founding of PAK|At a press conference in Stockholm, the exiled Andreas Papandreou presented the Panhellenic Liberation Movement, which resisted the junta.

event|03-05|1950|Βουλευτικές εκλογές μετά τον εμφύλιο|Parliamentary Elections after the Civil War|The first elections after the end of the Civil War took place without a clear winner and led to successive coalition governments.

event|04-07|1943|Ο Ιωάννης Ράλλης γίνεται πρωθυπουργός της κατοχικής κυβέρνησης|Ioannis Rallis Becomes Prime Minister of the Occupation Government|Rallis took over the administration under the German-Italian occupation and founded the Security Battalions.

event|04-13|2003|Το δυστύχημα των Τεμπών με μαθητές|The Tempe Accident Involving Students|A bus with children from Imathia, returning from an excursion, collided with a truck at Tempe and 21 students were killed.

event|04-16|2003|Η Συνθήκη Προσχώρησης στην Ευρωπαϊκή Ένωση υπογράφεται στην Αθήνα|The Treaty of Accession to the European Union Is Signed in Athens|Beneath the Stoa of Attalos, ten countries signed their accession to the Union, among them Cyprus.

event|05-07|1832|Το Πρωτόκολλο του Λονδίνου για το ελληνικό βασίλειο|The London Protocol on the Greek Kingdom|Britain, France and Russia officially recognized the Greek state as a kingdom and appointed Otto of Bavaria as king.

event|05-13|1912|Η πρώτη πτήση στρατιωτικού αεροπλάνου στην Ελλάδα|The First Flight of a Military Aeroplane in Greece|Lieutenant Dimitrios Kamberos flew a Farman aeroplane and opened the way for the Greek military aviation.

event|05-27|1963|Πεθαίνει ο Γρηγόρης Λαμπράκης|Grigoris Lambrakis Dies|The EDA member of parliament had been attacked in Thessaloniki on 22 May, after a speech in favour of peace. He became a symbol of the struggle for democracy.

event|06-18|1953|Οι Έλληνες στρατιώτες αποκρούουν την επίθεση στο ύψωμα Χάρρυ|Greek Soldiers Repel the Attack on Outpost Harry|The Greek expeditionary force in the Korean War repelled a strong Chinese attack, and the battle is remembered as one of its toughest.

event|06-18|1989|Διπλές εκλογές χωρίς αυτοδυναμία|Elections without a majority|Parliamentary and European elections were held on the same day. New Democracy won but lacked a majority, and a grand coalition government followed.

event|06-27|1976|Η αεροπειρατεία της πτήσης 139 της Air France|The hijacking of Air France Flight 139|The plane that had left Athens for Paris was seized by Palestinians and Germans and ended up in Entebbe, Uganda, where the hostage rescue operation took place.

event|06-27|2015|Ανακοινώνεται δημοψήφισμα|A referendum is announced|Prime Minister Alexis Tsipras announced that citizens would decide in a referendum on the creditors' proposal. The banks closed the next day.

event|06-29|1850|Αυτοκέφαλη η Εκκλησία της Ελλάδος|The Church of Greece becomes autocephalous|The Ecumenical Patriarchate recognised, by a patriarchal tomos, the independence of the Church of Greece, which had declared itself autocephalous in 1833.
event|07-06|1827|Η Συνθήκη του Λονδίνου για την Ελλάδα|The Treaty of London on Greece|Britain, France and Russia agreed to ask the Ottomans to grant autonomy to Greece and to accept their mediation.

event|08-06|2020|Συμφωνία Ελλάδας και Αιγύπτου για την ΑΟΖ|Greece and Egypt agree on an EEZ|The two countries signed an agreement delimiting their maritime zones in the Mediterranean, responding to the Turkey-Libya agreement.

event|09-08|1944|Οι Γερμανοί εκτελούν τη Λέλα Καραγιάννη|The Germans execute Lela Karagianni|The resistance fighter who had secretly cared for British soldiers and Jews was executed at Haidari, together with others, in reprisal.

event|09-11|1922|Το κίνημα του Πλαστήρα|Plastiras's coup|After the Asia Minor Catastrophe, officers led by Nikolaos Plastiras revolted, forced King Constantine to abdicate and brought those responsible to trial.
event|09-14|1829|Η Συνθήκη της Αδριανούπολης|The Treaty of Adrianople|Russia and the Ottoman Empire ended their war, and the treaty made it easier for the Greek state to be recognised.

event|09-24|1908|Οι Κρητικοί κηρύσσουν την ένωση με την Ελλάδα|The Cretans proclaim union with Greece|While the Ottoman Empire was weak, the Cretan State announced union, but the Great Powers suspended it. The date is in the Old Style calendar.
event|10-01|1861|Κυκλοφορούν τα πρώτα ελληνικά γραμματόσημα|The first Greek postage stamps are issued|The stamps bearing the head of Hermes were printed in Paris and used by the state post office.

event|10-09|1912|Η μάχη του Σαρανταπόρου|The Battle of Sarantaporo|The Greek army, commanded by Crown Prince Constantine, defeated the Ottomans in the pass and opened the way to Thessaloniki. The date is in the Old Style calendar.
event|10-11|1912|Η Κοζάνη ελευθερώνεται|Kozani is liberated|The Greek army entered the town during the First Balkan War, after the Battle of Sarantaporo. The date is in the Old Style calendar.

event|10-14|1944|Ο Ιερός Λόχος φτάνει στην ελεύθερη Αθήνα|The Sacred Band arrives in liberated Athens|A few days after the Germans withdrew, the first units of the Greek army of the Middle East landed at Piraeus.

event|10-29|1961|Οι εκλογές της «βίας και νοθείας»|The elections of "violence and fraud"|Konstantinos Karamanlis's ERE won with 50.8%. Georgios Papandreou denounced fraud and began the "relentless struggle".

event|11-07|1926|Πρώτες εκλογές με αναλογικό σύστημα|The first elections under proportional representation|The elections after the fall of Pangalos brought a government of all-party cooperation and put an end to the dictatorship.
event|11-14|1863|Η Συνθήκη του Λονδίνου για τα Επτάνησα|The Treaty of London on the Ionian Islands|Britain agreed to cede the Ionian Islands to Greece, after the arrival of King George I.

event|11-14|1973|Αρχίζει η εξέγερση του Πολυτεχνείου|The Polytechnic uprising begins|Students and citizens gathered at the Polytechnic against the junta, and the uprising ended with military intervention on 17 November.

event|11-19|1952|Ο Αλέξανδρος Παπάγος πρωθυπουργός|Alexandros Papagos becomes prime minister|The field marshal of the Greco-Italian War won the elections with his party, the Greek Rally, and governed until 1955.

event|11-28|1910|Ο Βενιζέλος κερδίζει τις δεύτερες εκλογές του έτους|Venizelos wins the year's second elections|The Liberal Party won a large majority and began a period of reforms. The date is in the Old Style calendar.

event|12-29|1966|Η απόφαση των ενόρκων για τη δολοφονία Λαμπράκη|The jury's verdict on the murder of Lambrakis|At the trial in Thessaloniki the jurors found the perpetrators guilty, and gendarmerie officers were also convicted.

event|01-01|1822|Η Α΄ Εθνοσυνέλευση της Επιδαύρου υιοθετεί το πρώτο Σύνταγμα|The First National Assembly at Epidaurus adopts the first Constitution|The delegates of revolutionary Greece voted the "Provisional Constitution" and proclaimed the nation's independence. The date is in the Old Style calendar.
event|01-01|1801|Ο Πιάτσι ανακαλύπτει την Δήμητρα|Piazzi discovers Ceres|The astronomer Giuseppe Piazzi saw from Palermo the first minor planet, which is today called a dwarf planet.
event|01-01|1804|Η Αϊτή γίνεται ανεξάρτητη|Haiti becomes independent|The former slaves who had rebelled against France proclaimed the world's first independent Black state.
